warnings: Realized returns use supplied unadjusted prices, explicit FX and booked net dividends/fees. Unrecorded costs or events are absent.
UTC calendar-day closes and 365 observations/year; no market-calendar alignment or automatic price carry-forward.
XIRR includes the closing marked value; it is not a cash-only realized-profit figure.
Supplied data quality is not independently verified. This report makes no GIPS compliance claim.
Short track record: annualized time-weighted return is withheld; ratios and tails are descriptive and statistically uncertain.
Selected-period report: opening market value is treated as invested capital for XIRR, not an original deposit.
